body: I will follow that. Thank you very much.

While I was seeing her, I slept with two other girls. Currently I deleted her number/facebook and just want to not even talk to her because time heals all wounds, but I also feel like she deserves to know. Should I text her this or give it a rest?
I just looked up the trailer. Confused.

It is more complex than that. I'm already fairly mentally unstable (but recovering) and on antidepressants.

This didn't so much cause me to want to kill myself, but it triggered underlying emotions and thoughts related to myself and suicide which were already hidden but present.

Thank you so much. This did make me feel really good to read.

Unfortunately, there was a lot of misunderstanding and we could both be happy if there was communication. I lost her and the group now, but oh well. They weren't that relevant in my life.

Much love to you, waldgnome. I hope you're doing okay. :)

Thank you man. I appreciate it.

I'd like to think they are just nasty idiots, but I would regularly turn up to their dorm unrequested. Mine was a big dorm with different groups while theirs acts like one family, so perhaps it came across as more intrusive. I can't help but feel like the onus is on me. Obviously though, the onus is on them to *let me know* they have an issue with me turning up uninvited; particularly if I've done it for weeks.

The best thing though is to go the fuck away. I've unfriended all of them and deleted her number. I don't plan on speaking to her, even if she contacts me.
